app.logInHint: Log in to manage this instance.
app.stalledTitle: The server did not come back
app.stalledBody: The new settings are saved, but nothing restarted the server. Start it again, or run nostube-server config rollback to return to the previous settings.
app.restartWarning: Saving restarts the server for a few seconds.

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.description: A few things to make the site your own.

items.pages: Fill in your About, Imprint and Privacy pages
items.lightning: Set a Lightning address to receive zaps

account.title: Login with a Nostr key
account.description: Your password always works. A bound NIP-07 key lets you log in with your signer too.
account.installSigner: Install a NIP-07 signer extension to bind a key.
account.deviceDescription: Devices that open this instance need to trust its certificate authority once.

signerModes.managed: Channel identity (managed key): this server keeps your key encrypted and signs for you. Whoever takes over the server gets the key too.
signerModes.own: Own identity: your browser's signer extension (NIP-07) signs. The server never sees the key.
signerModes.none: No signing key is set up yet. The Videos and Upload pages offer the choice.

account.exportHint: Exporting shows your secret key (nsec). Enter your admin password to confirm.
account.nsecWarning: Anyone who has this key can publish as you. Keep it somewhere safe, such as a password manager, and never share it.

appearance.siteDescription: The heading and the line below it on the public page.
appearance.title: Title
appearance.lightningHint: Optional. Lets viewers send you zaps (Bitcoin tips) from Nostr apps, e.g. name@getalby.com. It goes into the profile of the channel identity.
appearance.lightningInvalid: The Lightning address must look like name@domain.tld.
appearance.lookDescription: Visitors see light or dark mode following their system; the colour and font are yours.
appearance.accentHint: Buttons, links and the focus ring.

lowContrast.light: Little contrast against the light page background: buttons and links may be hard to see for some visitors.
lowContrast.dark: Little contrast against the dark page background: buttons and links may be hard to see for some visitors.
lowContrast.both: Little contrast against the light and dark page background: buttons and links may be hard to see for some visitors.

appearance.linksDescription: A description can mention people, videos of other creators and notes. Your site opens your own videos itself; everything else goes to the viewer you choose here.

presets.default: nostu.be for videos, njump.me for people and notes

appearance.profileHint: An https:// address with {nip19} where the identifier goes.

pages.intro: Optional pages the site links in its footer. Write each in the languages you want: visitors see their own language, otherwise English, otherwise the first language written. A page without any text is not shown and not linked.

descriptions.about: Who you are and what the site is about.
descriptions.imprint: Legal notice (Impressum), where the law of your country asks for one.

pages.size: {{count}} / {{max}} characters. Plain text: line breaks and web addresses work.
pages.useStandardAll: Standard text for all empty languages
pages.standardHint: The standard text describes what the Nostube site and server do with visitors' data and points to the imprint for the operator. It uses the visitor profile relays set on the Instance page at the moment you insert it; insert it again after changing them. Check that it matches how you run the instance. It is not legal advice.
pages.replaceConfirm: Replace the current text of this language with the standard text?

branding.title: Logo, favicon and banner
branding.description: Images for the public site. They apply right away, without saving.

hints.logo: In the header and on video pages, instead of the profile picture. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to {{size}}.
hints.favicon: The icon in the browser tab. PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or ICO, up to {{size}}.
hints.banner: A wide image above the videos on the start page. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to {{size}}.

crop.title: Crop {{image}}
crop.description: Drag to position, then zoom. Only the crop is uploaded: WebP, at most {{width}} × {{height}} px and {{kilobytes}} KB.
crop.loadError: This image could not be opened. Try PNG, JPEG or WebP.
crop.encodeError: This image could not be exported as WebP. Try another image or browser.

errors.tooBig: The file is too big: at most {{size}}.
errors.wrongType: This file type is not allowed here. See the formats above.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: The site shows every video of your creators except the ones you hide here. New uploads appear on their own.
videos.loadFailedWith: The videos could not be loaded ({{message}}).
videos.loadFailed: The videos could not be loaded.
videos.addCreator: Add a creator first to see their videos.
videos.emptyHint: Upload your first video and it appears here and on your site.
videos.noMatch: No video title matches the search.
videos.replaceHint: The video keeps its address and original publish date, even if its orientation changes. Unchanged thumbnails and subtitles are retained.
videos.deleteHint: This publishes a Nostr deletion request. The server removes the video and cleans up unused media, including its configured mirrors. Independent copies may remain elsewhere.
videos.saving: Uploading changes and awaiting relay acceptance…
videos.authorMismatch: Only the video's author can edit or delete it. Administrators may hide it instead.
videos.notAddressable: Only addressable video events can be edited or deleted here.
videos.eventMissing: The current video event is unavailable. Reload the video list before trying again.
videos.assetMissing: A subtitle is missing its file or URL.

scheduled.title: Scheduled videos
scheduled.cancelHint: The video and its files are removed from this server. This cannot be undone.

instance.searchHint: Off: the site has no search. Local: the site gets a search box that finds the shown videos by title, description and tags; it searches in the visitor's browser.

keys.invalid: Not a key: enter an npub, a 64-character hex key or a NIP-05 address (name@domain).
keys.notFound: No key found for {{address}}. Check the address, or paste the npub instead.

instance.creatorsDescription: Whose videos the site shows, and where they are read from.
instance.creatorsHint: Whose videos the site shows. Add an npub, a hex key or a NIP-05 address (name@domain).
instance.writersHint: These keys may publish to your relay and upload to your storage.
instance.videoSourcesHint: One ws:// or wss:// relay per line.
instance.interactionRelaysHint: One ws:// or wss:// relay per line. Used for profiles and, later, comments and zaps.
instance.profileRelaysDescription: When a visitor signs in, their name, picture and relay list are always looked up on the interaction relays, the public defaults wss://purplepag.es and wss://index.hzrd149.com, and the visitor's NIP-65 outbox relays. This list adds more lookup relays; it cannot disable the public defaults.
instance.profileRelaysHint: One ws:// or wss:// relay per line. Empty means no additional relays; public defaults and the visitor's NIP-65 outboxes are still queried.
instance.mirrorDescription: Copies this instance's own events and videos to servers you list, in the background. It keeps retrying while a target is down. Leave both lists empty to keep everything on this instance.
instance.mirrorRelaysHint: One ws:// or wss:// relay per line. Every new event of your creators is sent there.
instance.mirrorBlossomHint: One https:// server per line. Uploaded videos are copied there. This needs the managed signing key, because the server signs the mirror requests.
instance.fixed: Origin {{origin}} and TLS ({{tls}}) are fixed here.

upload.publishedDescription: The video is published on this instance's relay. It is not copied to other relays.
upload.publishedMirrored_one: The video is published on this instance and is being copied to {{count}} other relay in the background.
upload.publishedMirrored_other: The video is published on this instance and is being copied to {{count}} other relays in the background.
upload.title: Upload a video
upload.description: MP4 or WebM that your browser can play is published as it is; other videos (MOV, MKV, AVI, HEVC) are converted to MP4 in your browser first. It is stored on this instance and published to its relay.
upload.willConvert: converted to MP4 in this browser before the upload
upload.convertMemory: needs about {{gb}} GB of memory in this tab; close other tabs, or convert it to MP4 beforehand if the tab crashes
upload.tagsHint: Press Enter to add tags. Separate multiple tags with spaces or commas.
upload.notConnected: Your key is not yet a creator and uploader of this instance: connect it first.
upload.approveHint: Your signer asks you to approve the upload and the publication.
upload.needFutureDate: Set a publish date in the future.
upload.needSubtitleLanguage: Select a language for each subtitle.
upload.publishAtHint: Optional. Leave empty to publish now. Until then only this server holds the video.
upload.publishAtPast: Choose a date and time in the future.
upload.scheduledDescription: The video is stored on this instance and goes public on {{date}}. Until then it is on no relay and not on the site.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Comments on your videos. What you mute is hidden on this site only: muting deletes nothing, the comments stay on the relays and other Nostr apps may still show them.
moderation.loadFailed: The comments and the mute list could not be loaded ({{message}}).
moderation.listNote: Your public Nostr mute list (NIP-51), saved on the interaction relays of this instance. Anyone can read it, and other Nostr apps may apply it too.
moderation.privateKept: The list also has private (encrypted) entries. They stay as they are and are not shown here.
moderation.noComments: No comments on your videos yet.
moderation.reportVideoNote: This is one of your own videos. Hide or delete it from the Videos page.
moderation.reportSelfNote: This is the creator's own account or reply; there's nothing to mute here.

overview.description: What the built-in relay and Blossom server hold right now. Nothing here changes anything.
overview.loadFailed: The statistics could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
overview.databaseHint: The SQLite database with its write-ahead log.
overview.noEvents: The relay stores no events yet.
overview.activityDescription: Counted since the server last started; a restart sets them back to zero.

mirror.title: Mirror status
mirror.description: What the outbox has copied to your mirror servers. Changes to the target lists apply after saving.
mirror.loadFailed: The mirror status could not be loaded.
mirror.gaveUp: Gave up after {{count}} attempts. Retry to try again.

errors.noNip07: No NIP-07 signer found in this browser.
errors.noSigner: No Nostr signer found in this browser.
errors.notPubkey: The signer returned something that is not a public key.
errors.differentKey: Your signer uses a different key than this instance's creator key. Switch to that key in your signer and try again. Nothing was published.
errors.invalidSignature: The signer returned an invalid signature.
errors.noWebCodecs: This file has to be converted to MP4 first, and this browser cannot convert videos (no WebCodecs). Use a current Chrome, Edge or Safari, or convert it to MP4 beforehand.
errors.unreadableVideo: No video could be read from this file.
errors.cannotDecode: This browser cannot decode the video in this file, so it cannot convert it to MP4. Try another browser or convert it to MP4 beforehand.
errors.cannotEncode: This browser cannot encode H.264 video at this size, so it cannot convert the file to MP4. Try another browser or convert it to MP4 beforehand.
errors.tooLong: This video is too long to convert to MP4 in the browser: the MP4 would exceed 4 GB. Shorten it or convert it to MP4 beforehand.
errors.loadTimeout: The video took too long to load.
errors.cannotPlay: This browser cannot play the file.
errors.noDescriptor: The server did not answer with a blob description.
errors.hashMismatch: The server stored a different file than the one sent (the hashes differ).
errors.connectionFailed: The connection to the server failed.
errors.unfinished: The server did not finish the upload after the last piece.
errors.thumbnailType: The thumbnail must be an image with a MIME type.
errors.relayUnreachable: The instance's relay could not be reached. Check the instance address and that its TLS certificate is valid.
errors.listNotAccepted: No relay accepted the mute list. {{reasons}}
errors.titleEmpty: The title must not be empty.
errors.notVideoLink: Hidden videos: "{{line}}" is not a video link.
errors.notKey: {{label}}: "{{line}}" is not a hex or npub key.
errors.notRelay: {{label}}: "{{line}}" must be a ws:// or wss:// relay URL.
errors.notServer: {{label}}: "{{line}}" must be an http:// or https:// server address.
errors.notCount: {{label}} must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.pageText: {{page}}: each text must be at most {{max}} characters.

identity.intro: Every video is signed with a Nostr key. Choose whose key it is.
identity.ownBody: Videos are published under your own Nostr key, signed by your browser extension (NIP-07). The key also becomes your login key; your password keeps working.
identity.channelBody: This server creates a key for the channel and keeps it encrypted. Your password is all you need; you can export the key later under Account.
identity.loginWithNostr: I log in with my Nostr key
identity.noExtension: Already have a Nostr key? Install an extension such as nos2x or Alby and reload.

publishing.intro: Who should be able to find your videos?
publishing.localBody: Your videos stay on this site. Nothing is copied anywhere else.
publishing.networkBody: Also visible across the Nostr network: other apps can show and play your videos.
publishing.networkChannel: Copies of your video files are kept on public servers as well.
publishing.networkOwn: The video files stay on this site; other apps play them from here.
publishing.advancedHint: Technical details: your video events are copied to the mirror relays below (with the channel identity, the video files go to Blossom servers too). Profiles of signed-in visitors are always looked up on public default relays and their NIP-65 outbox relays.

site.appearance: After setup you can choose colours, font and logo on the Appearance page.

summary.hint: Finish creates the key if needed, saves everything at once and restarts the server for a few seconds.
